Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.paymentexecution

Class KfeTransactionEntity

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.model.paymentexecution.KfeTransactionEntity
@Entity public class KfeTransactionEntity extends Object
JPA representation of a payment transaction, including its idempotency, settlement, pricing, provider and confirmation-monitoring state.

The unique user/idempotency constraint prevents duplicate transaction intents. Lifecycle callbacks store UTC timestamps, and the indexes support user history, status and provider reconciliation queries.
